description: This file defines the DeliveryInd class, which represents an M-Delivery.Ind PDU (Protocol Data Unit) used in MMS messaging. It provides constructors and getter/setter methods for various header fields relevant to delivery indication messages.

classes.name: DeliveryInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS delivery indication message (M-Delivery.Ind PDU). Provides methods to access and modify message headers such as date, message ID, status, and recipients.

methods.name: DeliveryInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new DeliveryInd object, setting the message type to delivery indication.

methods.name: DeliveryInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a DeliveryInd object with specified headers.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the delivery indication.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the delivery indication.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Retrieves the Message-ID associated with the delivery indication.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the Message-ID for the delivery indication.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the delivery indication.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the delivery indication.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the recipient(s) of the delivery indication.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) for the delivery indication.
